text: Added a test-only org.scalafim.test.xor provider in a separate scalafim.zarr.external package using only public CodecCapability, CompiledCodec, SyncByteCodecExecutor, AsyncByteCodecExecutor, runtime, reader, writer, and metadata APIs. Direct and start-indexed sharded fixtures read on JVM and Scala.js; JVM create-only writes reproduce both encoded objects exactly; metadata and execution capability failures are independently asserted. No provider name or branch appears in core main sources. Full zarr gates passed warning-clean: JVM 77, Scala.js 75; git diff --check clean.
